
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/formulahendry/p/19789883" title="发布于 2026-03-29 09:09">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">王炸！VS Code 悄悄推出 Sessions App，全新的 Agentic 开发体验！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>大家好！我是韩老师。</span></p>
<p><span>如果你是 VS Code Insiders 版本的忠实用户，你也许就会发现 VS Code 悄悄推出了一个独立的 App，叫 Sessions。装了最新的 VS Code Insiders，就能在应用列表里面搜到名为 Sessions - Insiders 的 App。</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260329085931342-768123863.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>目前只随着&nbsp;<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,null]">VS Code Insiders 一起安装。</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260329090000664-652261610.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>其实，早在不久前，就有大神在 Reddit 分享了他的发现：</p>
<p><span>https://www.reddit.com/r/GithubCopilot/comments/1rflpau/vscode_sessions_insiders/</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260329090034509-705074566.png" alt="image" width="606" height="558" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>随即，就有 GitHub Copilot Team 的成员进行了回复：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260329090047047-510685760.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>agent-first!</strong></p>
<p><span>确实这个很重要！</span></p>
<p><span>于是，我也马上体验了下&nbsp;<span><span>Sessions App：</span></span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260329090354617-1237614452.png" alt="2d5fe5a1ad5cabbb4d9e44f2739be15a" width="1075" height="577" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>你会发现，这是一个全新的 UI 以及&nbsp;<span>agent-first 的开发体验。</span></span></p>
<p><span>以 Agent 与 Sessions 为中心。</span>IDE/编辑器功能大大弱化。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260329090341206-1616060138.png" alt="bbbfb33b136538b7af2f3b71e3ba19ec" width="840" height="535" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>想一探究竟？因为 VS Code 是完全开源的，你能很快地找到相关的源代码：</p>
<p><span>https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/tree/main/src/vs/sessions</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260329090431276-902205299.png" alt="c9a3f71be97e6c73cb3b1708a29b9a91" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>总体架构：</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260329090448057-179614712.png" alt="776ce737150a7b7eb7f05807b16c1c37" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>UI 布局：</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260329090458992-1216132930.png" alt="f361cd15072acc5b54a4d687b999b05a" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>写到这里，韩老师秃然发现，这个全新的 Sessions App，和我两个月前发布的 ACP UI 是不是长得有点像？！</span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2001255342038863950" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">用 Tauri 写了个 ACP UI，可以连接到任何 AI Agent</a></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260329090623186-1011519274.png" alt="image" width="1224" height="653" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<span>于是，我使用了《<span data-teams="true" data-pm-slice="0 0 []">米氏对比法<span>》，让 AI 帮我总结下 ACP UI 更强的地方。</span></span></span><span>（手动狗头</span>
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>ACP UI vs VS Code Sessions App 对比</span></h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>维度</span></th><th data-colwidth="227"><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></th><th><span>VS Code Session App</span></th><th><span>胜出</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>首次公开发布</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>2026-01-31<span>（v0.1.2）</span></span></td>
<td><span>代码存在于&nbsp;<code><span>microsoft/vscode</span></code><span>&nbsp;的&nbsp;<code><span>src/vs/sessions/</span></code><span>，但截至 2026-03 尚未作为独立可下载产品发布，仅在 VS Code Insiders 内部可用</span></span></span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>支持的 Agent 数量</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>9 个<span>开箱即用（Copilot、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、Auggie CLI、Qoder CLI、Codex CLI、OpenCode、OpenClaw）+ 任意 ACP 兼容 Agent（通过 JSON 配置无限扩展）</span></span></td>
<td><span>3 个<span>硬编码 provider（Copilot CLI、Copilot Cloud、Remote Agent Host），代码中 session type 仅支持&nbsp;<code><span>copilot-cli</span></code><span>、<code><span>copilot-cloud</span></code></span></span></span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>Agent 扩展性</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>✅ 任何人编辑&nbsp;<code><span>agents.json</span></code><span>&nbsp;即可添加任意 ACP Agent，支持热重载</span></span></td>
<td><span>❌ 需要实现&nbsp;<code><span>ISessionsProvider</span></code><span>&nbsp;接口注册新 provider，普通用户无法自行添加</span></span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>技术栈 / 运行时</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>Tauri 2 + Rust<span>&nbsp;后端 + Vue 前端</span></span></td>
<td><span>Electron<span>（整个 VS Code 的运行时）</span></span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>启动速度</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>⚡&nbsp;<span>极快<span>&nbsp;— Tauri/Rust 原生进程，WebView2/WKWebView 系统 WebView，无需加载整个 IDE</span></span></span></td>
<td><span>🐢&nbsp;<span>较慢<span>&nbsp;— 需启动完整 Electron + VS Code 工作台（即使是 "简化版" Agentic Workbench，仍加载大量 VS Code 服务）</span></span></span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>安装包大小</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>~3-5 MB<span>（Tauri 利用系统 WebView，不捆绑 Chromium）</span></span></td>
<td><span>~100+ MB<span>（VS Code Insiders 本体，捆绑完整 Chromium + Node.js）</span></span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>内存安全性</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>✅&nbsp;<span>Rust<span>&nbsp;后端 — 编译时内存安全保证，无 GC，无 use-after-free</span></span></span></td>
<td><span>⚠️&nbsp;<span>TypeScript/JavaScript on Node.js<span>&nbsp;— 依赖 V8 GC，Electron IPC 攻击面较大</span></span></span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>独立性</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>✅&nbsp;<span>完全独立<span>&nbsp;— 下载即用，不依赖任何 IDE</span></span></span></td>
<td><span>❌&nbsp;<span>依赖 VS Code Insiders<span>&nbsp;— 必须安装 VS Code，通过&nbsp;<code><span>--sessions</span></code><span>&nbsp;启动或&nbsp;<code><span>vscode-sessions-insiders://</span></code><span>&nbsp;协议打开</span></span></span></span></span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>开源协议</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>✅&nbsp;<span>MIT<span>&nbsp;— 完全开源</span></span></span></td>
<td><span>⚠️ VS Code OSS 部分开源（MIT），但 Insiders 产品为 Microsoft 专有许可</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>跨平台支持</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>✅ Windows (.msi/.exe)、macOS (ARM64/x64 .dmg)、Linux x64/ARM64 (.deb/.rpm/.AppImage)</span></td>
<td><span>✅ Windows、macOS、Linux（同 VS Code）</span></td>
<td><span>🤝 平手</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>协议调试</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>✅&nbsp;<span>内置 Traffic Monitor<span>&nbsp;— 实时查看 ACP 协议报文</span></span></span></td>
<td><span>❌ 无内置协议调试工具</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>配置热重载</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>✅ 修改&nbsp;<code><span>agents.json</span></code><span>&nbsp;无需重启</span></span></td>
<td><span>❌ 需通过代码更改 provider</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>代码量/复杂度</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="227"><span>~1 MB<span>&nbsp;仓库，极简代码</span></span></td>
<td><code><span>src/vs/sessions/</span></code><span>&nbsp;有大量文件和复杂架构，整个 VS Code 仓库体量巨大</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI（轻量级优势）</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><span><br></span><span>好家伙？ACP UI 全胜？（手动狗头</span></p>
